sources.title: MULAN: Multi-modal Causal Structure Learning and Root Cause Analysis for Microservice Systems
sources.verified_boundary: Reactive root-cause ranking from metrics and logs; datasets contain 4, 5, and 5 system faults.

sources.title: GALR: Graph-Based Root Cause Localization and LLM-Assisted Recovery for Microservice Systems
sources.role: nearest graph-plus-LLM localization and recovery method
sources.verified_boundary: Post-event localization/recovery; injection-time-aligned window labels; two-run averages; no significance test; recovery plans evaluated offline.

sources.title: Between Promise and Pain: The Reality of Automating Failure Analysis in Microservices with LLMs
sources.role: empirical evidence on tool-augmented LLM-agent failure modes
sources.verified_boundary: LLM agents can misuse tools, apply shallow fixes, misread stale signals, and take unnecessary or potentially harmful actions.

sources.title: From Distributed Tracing to Proactive SLO Management: A Mini-Review of Trace-Driven Performance Prediction for Cloud-Native Microservices
sources.role: evaluation frame for proactive SLO and prefix early warning
sources.verified_boundary: Early-warning evaluation should combine a precision constraint with earliness, coverage, and false-alarm measures; proxy labels must be distinguished from real SLO semantics.

sources.title: A Survey of AIOps in the Era of Large Language Models
sources.role: broad LLM4AIOps taxonomy and evaluation context
sources.verified_boundary: Survey of 183 articles published from 2020 through 2024; background taxonomy rather than a directly comparable experiment.
